free_text: The 74-year-old male presents with an elevated PSA of 8.0 ng/mL and a prior biopsy grade of 3+3. MRI revealed a focal area of markedly restricted diffusion in the left mid-base transition zone (PI-RADS 5). Pathology confirmed focal adenocarcinoma with a Gleason pattern 3+3, ISUP grade group 1, localized to the transition zone. Management assessment indicates clinical review is required to distinguish tumor risk from patient preferences for surveillance.
